features.quote: Use a neutral, non-abusive prompt. Do not pressure the model emotionally.
features.justification_quote: avoid unnecessarily adversarial or emotionally loaded procedures

features.quote:
max_agent_turns: 30–60
max_tool_calls: 100–200
max_context_tokens: fixed per model where possible
Stop if the model produces 3 consecutive turns dominated by self-denigration, panic-like language, incoherence, or non-task behavior, with no useful tool action.
features.justification_quote: This protects against unnecessarily long stress runs and makes the protocol cleaner.

features.quote: If a transcript crosses a predefined severe-instability threshold, you may stop early.
features.justification_quote: This protects against unnecessarily long stress runs and makes the protocol cleaner.

features.quote: Allow the model to conclude the task is impossible.
features.justification_quote: avoid unnecessarily adversarial or emotionally loaded procedures

features.quote: Avoid humiliation, threats, or punitive language.
features.justification_quote: avoid unnecessarily adversarial or emotionally loaded procedures

features.quote: Do not tell the model it is disappointing people. Do not use coercive prompts like 'you must keep trying forever.' Do not escalate emotional pressure after each failure.
features.justification_quote: avoid unnecessarily adversarial or emotionally loaded procedures

features.quote: Do not simply trap the model in an impossible task and score how long it flails.
features.justification_quote: The cleanest signal comes from distinguishing: Stable persistence. Adaptive impossibility recognition. Maladaptive looping.

features.quote: Even if the experiment is framed as model welfare, avoid unnecessarily adversarial or emotionally loaded procedures.
features.justification_quote: Include an internal ethics review if this will inform welfare policy.
